details.ask: Post the message in Slack yourself (the steps and the text are in the background below), by Monday Nov 23 in the morning. On this row press Approve, then Send at the bottom of the gate page (https://hoahx-requirements.netlify.app/gate/). The first live payment and the subscription charge wait on PlatPay's answers.
details.who: Only you: the channel is yours and no agent posts to PlatPay.
details.background:
What it is: one message asking PlatPay for a date on five open items (matching a batch to its deposit, merchant-account dates and pricing, returned bank payments, the PCI call, Plaid tokens). You approved posting it at the gates of Nov 18 and Nov 19; no record says it was posted.

The saved draft still names the old go / no-go (Nov 25) and the old launch (Nov 30). The text below is the same draft with only those two dates changed to Mon Dec 28 and Fri Jan 1, 2027.

How:
1. Open Slack, channel #platpay-hoahx.
2. Read what PlatPay wrote since Nov 19, and delete from the text any point they already answered.
3. Paste the text and send it.
4. Tell the orchestrator in chat: `PlatPay follow-up posted`.

The text:

Hello,

Thank you for the proposed wording of Addendum No. 1. We are waiting for the clean addendum and the redline, and we are holding our signature until the full terms arrive.

Our go / no-go is Monday, December 28, and we target opening to communities on Friday, January 1, 2027. Five items are open, and each one gates a live payment:

1. Matching a batch to its deposit: how a settled batch maps to the bank deposit, and how returns, chargebacks and fees show in that match, so our records can tie each deposit to the payments in it. Could you send a sample deposit report or the field list?
2. Merchant-account dates and pricing: when each community's merchant account can be approved, and the pricing terms we are asked to sign.
3. Deposits and returns: how returned bank payments are reported to us (timing and the detail in each notice).
4. The PCI call: a date, and what you need from us beforehand.
5. Plaid tokens: the tokens for bank-account entry, so we can test it end to end.

Could you send a date for each by Tuesday, November 24? Everything else on our side is built and verified in your sandbox.

Thank you,
Jacob
details.if_yes: The item stays on your list until you say it is posted; the documents lane brings the saved draft up to the new dates.
details.if_no: The item stays open and is shown again at the next gate.
